-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics

theorem backend.rtHeld_eq (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b rtx : Loc) (rv :
    backend.RView) : backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx rv = backend.rtHeldF γ P b rtx rv sync.rfrac.half

theorem backend.batchViewQ_of_exact (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess)
    : ghostVar γ.view (Qp.half 1).half (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) ⊢ backend.batchViewQ γ P st

def backend.cachedAt (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  (ver, i) ↪[γ.cached]□ true

theorem backend.thinV_dl (γ : backend.BNames) (vd L : backend.VData) : backend.thinV γ vd L ⊢ □ ∀
    nk, ⌜L !! nk ≠ none ∧ vd !! nk = none⌝ -∗ backend.dlIs γ nk

theorem backend.bOpen_add (γ : backend.BNames) (p q : Qp) : backend.bOpen γ (p + q) ⊣⊢ backend.bOpen
    γ p ∗ backend.bOpen γ q

def backend.cbufOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (b : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBufferCache go!"buf" (backend.cacheOf b)

def backend.rbOwnIn (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) :
    IProp GF :=
  backend.rbPartF γ S r fun x => false

theorem backend.bViewC_bView (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) (c : Bool) :
    backend.bViewC γ q vd c ⊢ backend.bView γ q vd

def backend.metricsInv (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  inv (backend.bN.@"metrics")
    iprop(∃ a c d e,
        typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"size" b) a (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"sizeInUse" b) c (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"commits" b) d (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"openReadTxN" b) e
                (DFrac.own 1))

theorem backend.plHookRO_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoFunc) : Persistent (backend.plHookRO
    γ f)

theorem backend.fkRd_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) :
    Persistent (backend.fkRd γ P rv)

def backend.qsum (outs : GMap Nat Qp) : Rat :=
  (List.map (fun x => x.snd.val) outs.toList).sum

def backend.qpRep (q s : Qp) : Nat → Qp :=
  Nat.brecOn x✝ (backend.qpRep._f q s)

def backend.intvInv (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rtx : Loc) (cm : GoMap) (D :
    backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(inv (backend.bN.@"intv")
        iprop(∃ M qm,
            □ backend.cmFacts P rtx D M ∗ ⌜0 ≤ qm ∧ qm ≤ 1⌝ ∗ backend.mapPart cm qm M ∗ backend.tokPart γ (1 - qm)) ∗
      inv (backend.bN.@"stats") iprop(backend.rtxStats rtx ∨ ghostVar γ.txb 1 ()))

def backend.hkPut (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n k : GoString) (S : backend.Data) :
    IProp GF :=
  if P.hk n k = true then backend.hkOwn γ (backend.hkData P S) else iprop(True)

def backend.wbTok (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  ownToks γ.wb 1

def backend.rdSlices (rtx : Loc) (ss : List GoSlice) (bs : List GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ss.length = bs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ ss.zip bs, backend.rdB rtx x.fst x.snd)

def backend.crtSnap (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b crt rtx : Loc) (rv :
    backend.RView) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m Pb cm tm wg γw γo γt k q rt,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.rtmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) tm DFrac.discard ∗
          backend.rbAt (backend.rbufOf (backend.cbaseOf crt)) DFrac.discard m Pb rv.snd ∗
            typedPointsto (backend.rtxOf (backend.cbaseOf crt)) rtx DFrac.discard ∗
              typedPointsto (backend.rbktOf (backend.cbaseOf crt)) cm DFrac.discard ∗
                typedPointsto (backend.rtmuOf (backend.cbaseOf crt)) tm DFrac.discard ∗
                  typedPointsto (backend.rwgOf (backend.cbaseOf crt)) wg DFrac.discard ∗
                    (sync.ownRWMutex tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗
                      (sync.isRWMutexGuard tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗
                        backend.rdShare rtx γo k q ∗
                          backend.rtxSnap rtx rv.fst ∗
                            □ backend.intvInv γ P rtx cm rv.fst ∗
                              □ backend.wgInv γ rtx wg γw γo γt ∗ ⌜rv.snd.Wf ∧ backend.idsOk P rv.snd.bks ∧ P.Wf⌝)

theorem backend.fkVR_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (g : backend.FkG) : Persistent (backend.fkVR γ
    g)

theorem backend.fkOwn_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) : Timeless (backend.fkOwn γ n)

theorem backend.fkOpen_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) (v : backend.FkVals) : Persistent
    (backend.fkOpen γ n v)

theorem backend.metricsInv_persistent (b : Loc) : Persistent (backend.metricsInv b)

def backend.fkPut (γ : backend.BNames) (n k : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  if backend.fkKey n k then iprop(∃ f, backend.fkOwn γ f) else iprop(True)

def backend.hooksReq (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b t : Loc) (h :
    GoInterface) (X Y : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ho,
      ⌜h = GoInterface.ok ho⌝ ∗
        □
          ∀ st stop m u,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ Pk ∗ X ∗ ⌜backend.hookPre P st⌝ ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u -∗
                  ▷
                      ((∃ st',
                          backend.batchLocked γ P b st' ∗
                            Pk ∗ Y ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u ∗ ⌜backend.hookStep P st st'⌝) -∗
                        Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods ho.ty
                            go!"OnPreCommitUnsafe"
                            ho.v))
                        (intoVal
                          (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                            (intoVal t))))
                      {{ Φ }})

def backend.batchLockedAt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b t db : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(sync.ownMutex (backend.muOf t) ∗
      backend.batchPhys γ b t db st ∗ backend.batchGhost γ P st ∗ ⌜backend.sessWf P st⌝)

def backend.rdOpen : Qp :=
  (Qp.half 1).divide_even sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat backend.rdOpen._proof_2

def backend.rdShare (rtx : Loc) (γo : GName) (k : Nat) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.txLive rtx q ∗ k ↪[γo] q)

def backend.bksOk (Pb : backend.BksPhys) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (id : w64) (x : Loc × backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent),
    Pb !! id = some x → B !! id = some es → backend.bbOk x.snd es

def backend.batchPhys (γ : backend.BNames) (b t db : Loc) (st : backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ hk,
      typedPointsto (backend.txFOf t) st.tx (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.pendOf t) st.pend (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.delOf t) st.ndel (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            backend.ownWB (backend.wbOf t) st.W ∗
              typedPointsto
                  (backend.bF
                    go!"txPostLockInsideApplyHook"
                    b)
                  hk (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                dghostVar γ.hook (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) hk ∗
                  backend.ownDB db γ.db st.C ∗
                    backend.ownWTx st.tx γ.db st.C st.S ∗
                      backend.txDB st.tx db ∗
                        sync.ownRWMutex (backend.bF go!"mu" b) fun q =>
                          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"db" b) db (DFrac.own q))

def backend.fkHalf (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ f g, monoNatAuthOwn γ.fk (Qp.half 1) f ∗ backend.fkVR γ g ∗ ⌜backend.fkOkG P f g st⌝)

def backend.batchGhostAt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (free :
    Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.batchViewQ γ P st ∗
      ∃ n w u,
        ghostVar γ.rvs (Qp.half 1) ((st.C, st.R), false) ∗
          ownTokAuth γ.wb n ∗
            monoNatAuthOwn γ.wbc 1 w ∗
              ghostVar γ.used (Qp.half 1) u ∗
                dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half) false ∗
                  backend.trkHalf γ P st.S ∗ backend.fkHalf γ P st ∗ ⌜backend.bgOk P st free n w u⌝)

def backend.cacheEnt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (bp : Loc) (ver : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c Pc i rv,
      typedPointsto bp c DFrac.discard ∗
        backend.bksAt c.txBuffer'.buckets' DFrac.discard Pc rv.snd.bks ∗
          backend.histAt γ ver i rv ∗
            backend.cachedAt γ ver i ∗ ⌜rv.snd.Wf ∧ backend.idsOk P rv.snd.bks ∧ c.bufVersion' = W64 0⌝)

def backend.commitReq (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) (X Y :
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ (X -∗ Y) ∨
      ∃ t h,
        typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"hooks" b) h DFrac.discard ∗
            backend.hooksReq γ P Pk b t h X Y)

def backend.cbaseOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (rt : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.concurrentReadTx
    go!"baseReadTx" rt

theorem backend.qpRep.eq_def (q s : Qp) (x✝ : Nat) : backend.qpRep q s x✝ = match x✝ with | 0 => q |
    n.succ => backend.qpRep q s n + s

theorem backend.qpRep_val (q s : Qp) (n : Nat) : (backend.qpRep q s n).val = q.val + ↑n * s.val

def backend.rwgOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"txWg" base

theorem backend.plHook_persist (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoFunc) : backend.plHook γ f ⊢ |==>
    backend.plHookRO γ f

theorem backend.histAt_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) (rv : backend.RView) :
    Persistent (backend.histAt γ ver i rv)

def backend.mapPart (cm : GoMap) (q : Rat) (M : GMap w64 Loc) : IProp GF :=
  if h : 0 < q then ownMap cm (DFrac.own ⟨q, h⟩) M else iprop(True)

theorem backend.relog_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (L : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) (st :
    backend.BSess) (nk : GoString × GoString) : backend.relog P L st !! nk = (backend.sData P st.S
    !! nk).or (if backend.vData P (st.C, st.R) !! nk = none then L !! nk else none)

def backend.rtHeldF (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b rtx : Loc) (rv : backend.RView) (p
    : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rt rd H L,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
        sync.ownRWMutexRLocked (backend.rmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (backend.rtRes γ P rt) ∗
          backend.rtResAt γ P rt sync.rfrac rd rv H p L ∗ ⌜rd.rtx = rtx ∧ rtx ≠ null⌝ ∗ backend.crTok γ b)

def backend.rdTok (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rt,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
        sync.ownRWMutex (backend.rmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (backend.rtRes γ P rt) ∗ backend.crTok γ b)

theorem backend.thinV_relog (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (L : backend.VData) (st :
    backend.BSess) : backend.thinV γ (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) L ⊢ backend.thinV γ
    (backend.sData P st.S) (backend.relog P L st)

theorem backend.hooksSpec_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b t
    : Loc) (h : GoInterface) : Persistent (backend.hooksSpec γ P Pk b t h)

def backend.bViewC (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) (c : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.view q.half vd ∗ ghostVar γ.cvw q.half () ∗ ghostVar γ.cln q.half c)

theorem backend.cacheInv_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) : Persistent (backend.cacheInv γ)

theorem backend.trkHalf_eq (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {S S' : backend.Data} (h1 :
    backend.hkData P S' = backend.hkData P S) (h2 : backend.rbData P S' = backend.rbData P S) :
    backend.trkHalf γ P S = backend.trkHalf γ P S'

def backend.thinV (γ : backend.BNames) (vd L : backend.VData) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∀ (nk : GoString × GoString) (v : GoString), vd !! nk = some v → L !! nk = some v⌝ ∗
      □ ∀ nk, ⌜L !! nk ≠ none ∧ vd !! nk = none⌝ -∗ backend.dlIs γ nk)

def backend.bStopped (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.opn DFrac.discard true

def backend.tmTok (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.txa q () ∗ ghostVar γ.txb q ())

def backend.fkCl (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.fkOwn γ (backend.fkInit D) ∗ backend.fkVR γ (backend.fkWInit P D, backend.fkInit D, backend.fkVals D))

theorem backend.batchLocked_thin (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.bView γ q
    vd ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.bView γ q vd ∗ backend.thinV γ (backend.vData P
    (st.C, st.R)) vd

def backend.rbufOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"buf" base

theorem backend.clnPart_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (q : Qp) (rd :
    backend.RdSt) (rv : backend.RView) : Timeless (backend.clnPart γ P q rd rv)

def backend.rdB (rtx : Loc) (s : GoSlice) (b : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownSlice s b DFrac.discard ∨ backend.txBytes rtx s b)

def backend.wgBody (γ : backend.BNames) (rtx : Loc) (γwg : sync.WaitGroupNames) (γw γo γt : GName) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ n outs pool,
        sync.ownWaitGroup γwg n ∗
          ghostMapAuth γo 1 outs ∗
            backend.txLive rtx pool ∗
              ownToks γ.rdt (sint.nat n) ∗
                ⌜sint.Z n = ↑outs.size ∧ pool.val + backend.qsum outs = 1 / 2⌝ ∗
                  (sync.ownWaitGroupWaiters γwg 0 ∨ backend.wgOpen γw 1)) ∨
      ghostMapAuth γo 1 ∅ ∗ backend.wgOpen γw 1 ∗ ghostVar γt 1 ())

def backend.fkRd (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ f g, monoNatLbOwn γ.fk f ∗ backend.fkVR γ g ∗ ⌜backend.fkOkRvG P f g rv⌝)

theorem backend.tokPart_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Rat) : Timeless (backend.tokPart γ q)

theorem backend.rbOwn_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : Timeless
    (backend.rbOwn γ r)

def backend.batchLocked (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st : backend.BSess) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ t db,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ∗
        backend.batchLockedAt γ P b t db st)

def (sealed) backend.rbSide (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) : IProp GF

def backend.batchGhost (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  backend.batchGhostAt γ P st false

theorem backend.relog_exact (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : backend.relog P
    (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) st = backend.sData P st.S

def backend.batchViewQ (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L, backend.viewQ γ (Qp.half 1).half (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) L)

theorem backend.cacheEnt_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (bp : Loc) (ver :
    w64) : Persistent (backend.cacheEnt γ P bp ver)

def backend.viewQ (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (phys L : backend.VData) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.view q L ∗ backend.thinV γ phys L)

def backend.rtIntv (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (q : Qp) (rd : backend.RdSt) (cm :
    GoMap) (D : backend.Data) (p : Qp := q.half) : IProp GF :=
  if rd.live = true then
    iprop(backend.txLive rd.rtx p ∗
        backend.rtxSnap rd.rtx D ∗
          □ backend.intvInv γ P rd.rtx cm D ∗
            □ backend.wgInv γ rd.rtx rd.wg rd.γw rd.γo rd.γt ∗ backend.wgOpen rd.γw q ∗ ghostVar rd.γt q ())
  else iprop(⌜rd.rtx = null⌝ ∗ backend.bStopped γ)

def backend.VData : Type :=
  GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString

def backend.rtRes (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rt : Loc) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rd rv H L, backend.rtResAt γ P rt q rd rv H q.half L)

theorem backend.cachedAt_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) : Persistent
    (backend.cachedAt γ ver i)

def backend.rmuOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"mu" base

theorem backend.viewQ_exact (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) : ghostVar γ.view q
    vd ⊢ backend.viewQ γ q vd vd

theorem backend.hookFnSpec_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b
    t : Loc) (f : GoFunc) : Persistent (backend.hookFnSpec γ P Pk b t f)

theorem backend.rbEls_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (q : Qp) (v : GoString →
    Option backend.BktData × Bool) : Timeless (backend.rbEls γ S q v)

def backend.clnPart (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (q : Qp) (rd : backend.RdSt) (rv :
    backend.RView) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.cln q.half rd.cln ∗ ⌜rd.cln = true → backend.rbClean P rv.snd⌝)

def backend.histAt (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) (rv : backend.RView) : IProp GF :=
  (ver, i) ↪[γ.hist]□ rv

theorem backend.thinV_trans (γ : backend.BNames) (a b c : backend.VData) : backend.thinV γ a b ∗
    backend.thinV γ b c ⊢ backend.thinV γ a c

theorem backend.bOpen_one_shares (γ : backend.BNames) : backend.bOpen γ 1 ⊣⊢ backend.bOpen γ
    (Qp.half 1) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.bOpen
    γ backend.rdOpen

theorem backend.cacheValid_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rv :
    backend.RView) (idx : Nat) (L : backend.VData) : Persistent (backend.cacheValid γ P rv idx L)

def backend.btOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered go!"batchTx" t

def backend.pendOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTx go!"pending"
    (backend.btOf t)

theorem backend.rbPut_other (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n : GoString) (S :
    backend.Data) (h : P.RB n = false) : ⊢ backend.rbPut γ P n S

theorem backend.dlIs_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (nk : GoString × GoString) : Persistent
    (backend.dlIs γ nk)

def backend.rbPut (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n : GoString) (S : backend.Data) :
    IProp GF :=
  if P.RB n = true then backend.rbPart γ (fun m => m = n) (backend.rbData P S) else iprop(True)

theorem backend.dlReg_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (Φ : GoString × GoString → IProp GF) :
    Persistent (backend.dlReg γ Φ)

theorem backend.mapPart_timeless (cm : GoMap) (q : Rat) (M : GMap w64 Loc) : Timeless
    (backend.mapPart cm q M)

def backend.wbOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered go!"buf" t

theorem backend.thinV_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (vd L : backend.VData) : Persistent
    (backend.thinV γ vd L)

def backend.wgInv (γ : backend.BNames) (rtx wg : Loc) (γw γo γt : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γwg,
      sync.isWaitGroup wg γwg (backend.bN.@"wg") ∗
        inv (backend.bN.@"wgi") (backend.wgBody γ rtx γwg γw γo γt) ∗ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.rdt DFrac.discard backend.rdMax)

structure backend.RdSt : Type where
  rtx : Loc
  wg : Loc
  γw : GName
  γo : GName
  γt : GName
  idx : Nat
  win : Bool
  live : Bool
  cln : Bool

def backend.relog (P : backend.BParams) (L : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) (st :
    backend.BSess) : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString :=
  backend.sData P st.S ∪ GMap.filter (fun nk x => decide (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R) !! nk = none)) L

theorem backend.wgBody_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (rtx : Loc) (γwg : sync.WaitGroupNames) (γw γo
    γt : GName) : Timeless (backend.wgBody γ rtx γwg γw γo γt)

def backend.baseOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (rt : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.readTx
    go!"baseReadTx" rt

theorem backend.dlNoDel_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) : Persistent (backend.dlNoDel γ)

theorem backend.batchViewQ_bView (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (q
    : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) : backend.batchViewQ γ P st ∗ backend.bView γ q vd ⊢
    backend.batchViewQ γ P st ∗ backend.bView γ q vd ∗ backend.thinV γ (backend.vData P (st.C,
    st.R)) vd

def backend.cmFacts (P : backend.BParams) (rtx : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (M : GMap w64 Loc) : IProp
    GF :=
  [∗map] i ↦ bk ∈ M,
    iprop(∃ n,
        ⌜P.BT !! n = some i⌝ ∗
          (⌜D !! n = none ∧ bk = null⌝ ∨ ∃ m, ⌜D !! n = some m ∧ bk ≠ null⌝ ∗ backend.rBkt rtx bk (backend.bktEnts m)))

theorem backend.bView_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) : Timeless
    (backend.bView γ q vd)

theorem backend.poisonAt_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) : Persistent
    (backend.poisonAt γ ver i)

def backend.rbPart (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ F, backend.rbPartF γ S r F)

def backend.baseRd (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (base : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (rtx : Loc)
    (rv : backend.RView) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m Pb cm tm,
      backend.rbAt (backend.rbufOf base) dq m Pb rv.snd ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.rtxOf base) rtx dq ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.rbktOf base) cm dq ∗
            typedPointsto (backend.rtmuOf base) tm DFrac.discard ∗
              (sync.ownRWMutex tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗
                (sync.isRWMutexGuard tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗
                  backend.txLive rtx q ∗
                    backend.rtxSnap rtx rv.fst ∗
                      □ backend.intvInv γ P rtx cm rv.fst ∗
                        ⌜rv.snd.Wf ∧
                            backend.idsOk P rv.snd.bks ∧ P.Wf ∧ (dq = DFrac.discard ∨ backend.bksOk Pb rv.snd.bks)⌝)

def backend.plHookAt (γ : backend.BNames) (dq : DFrac) (f : GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.hook dq f

def backend.rbPutAll (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n : GoString) (S : backend.Data) :
    IProp GF :=
  if P.RB n = true then backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P S) else iprop(True)

theorem backend.bViewC_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) (c : Bool) :
    Timeless (backend.bViewC γ q vd c)

def backend.hkOwn (γ : backend.BNames) (d : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.hkd (Qp.half 1) d

theorem backend.rbPutAll_other (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (n : GoString) (S :
    backend.Data) (h : P.RB n = false) : ⊢ backend.rbPutAll γ P n S

theorem backend.rbPart_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) : Timeless (backend.rbPart γ S r)

def backend.rtCore (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rt : Loc) (q : Qp) (rd :
    backend.RdSt) (rv : backend.RView) (cm : GoMap) (H : GMap (w64 × Nat) backend.RView) (p : Qp :=
    q.half) (L : backend.VData := backend.vData P rv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.rd q rd ∗
      ghostVar γ.rvs q.half (rv, rd.win) ∗
        ghostVar γ.cur q.half ((rv.snd.ver, rd.idx), rd.win) ∗
          backend.clnPart γ P q rd rv ∗
            ghostMapAuth γ.hist q H ∗
              typedPointsto (backend.rtxOf (backend.baseOf rt)) rd.rtx (DFrac.own q) ∗
                typedPointsto (backend.rwgOf (backend.baseOf rt)) rd.wg (DFrac.own q) ∗
                  ⌜rv.snd.Wf ∧
                        backend.idsOk P rv.snd.bks ∧
                          H !! (rv.snd.ver, rd.idx) = some rv ∧
                            (∀ (k : w64 × Nat) (rv' : backend.RView),
                                H !! k = some rv' → backend.keyLe k (rv.snd.ver, rd.idx)) ∧
                              (rd.win = true → rd.idx = 0) ∧ backend.safeRv P rv⌝ ∗
                    backend.histAt γ rv.snd.ver rd.idx rv ∗
                      backend.cacheValid γ P rv rd.idx L ∗
                        (if rd.win = true then backend.poisonAt γ rv.snd.ver rd.idx else True) ∗
                          ownTokAuthDfrac γ.rdt DFrac.discard backend.rdMax ∗
                            backend.rtIntv γ P q rd cm rv.fst p ∗ backend.fkRd γ P rv)

def backend.payIn (γ : backend.BNames) (st : backend.BSess) (stop : Bool) (m u : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  if stop = true then
    iprop(dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) false ∗ dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half) false)
  else
    if m = 0 then backend.wbTok γ
    else
      if m = 1 then iprop(ghostVar γ.used (Qp.half 1) u ∗ monoNatLbOwn γ.wbc (u + 1))
      else iprop(⌜st.cnt.c = 0⌝ ∗ monoNatLbOwn γ.wbc 1)

theorem backend.viewQ_split (γ : backend.BNames) (a b : Qp) (phys L : backend.VData) : backend.viewQ
    γ (a + b) phys L ⊣⊢ backend.viewQ γ a phys L ∗ backend.viewQ γ b phys L

def backend.rtRest (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rt : Loc) (q : Qp) (rd :
    backend.RdSt) (rv : backend.RView) (cm : GoMap) (H : GMap (w64 × Nat) backend.RView) (p : Qp :=
    q.half) (L : backend.VData := backend.vData P rv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.viewQ γ q.half.half (backend.vData P rv) L ∗ backend.rtCore γ P rt q rd rv cm H p L)

theorem backend.wgInv_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (rtx wg : Loc) (γw γo γt : GName) : Persistent
    (backend.wgInv γ rtx wg γw γo γt)

theorem backend.hooksReq_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b t
    : Loc) (h : GoInterface) (X Y : IProp GF) : Persistent (backend.hooksReq γ P Pk b t h X Y)

theorem backend.rbOwnIn_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) : Timeless (backend.rbOwnIn γ S r)

def backend.crTok (γ : backend.BNames) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rt tm,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.rtmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) tm DFrac.discard ∗
          (sync.ownRWMutex tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗ ownToks γ.rdt 1)

theorem backend.relog_congr (P : backend.BParams) (L : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) {st st'
    : backend.BSess} (hS : backend.sData P st.S = backend.sData P st'.S) (hC : st.C = st'.C) (hR :
    st.R = st'.R) : backend.relog P L st = backend.relog P L st'

def backend.rbElem (γ : backend.BNames) (n : GoString) (q : Qp) (v : Option backend.BktData × Bool)
    : IProp GF :=
  n ↪[γ.rbk]{#q} v

theorem backend.bStopped_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) : Persistent (backend.bStopped γ)

theorem backend.bOpen_rep (γ : backend.BNames) (q s : Qp) (n : Nat) : backend.bOpen γ (backend.qpRep
    q s n) ⊣⊢ backend.bOpen γ q ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), backend.bOpen γ s

def backend.kvsOutRd (rtx : Loc) (keys vals : GoSlice) (res : List backend.Ent) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ks vs,
      ownSlice keys ks (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ownSliceCap GoSlice keys (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ownSlice vals vs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSliceCap GoSlice vals (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              backend.rdSlices rtx ks (List.map Prod.fst res) ∗ backend.rdSlices rtx vs (List.map Prod.snd res))

def backend.txFOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTx go!"tx" (backend.btOf t)

def backend.batchFree (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b t : Loc) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ st db, backend.batchPhys γ b t db st ∗ backend.batchGhostAt γ P st true ∗ ⌜backend.freeOk P st⌝ ∗ W ∗ Pk) ∨
      backend.bStopped γ)

def backend.bOpen (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own q.half) false ∗ ghostVar γ.cls q ())

def backend.rtxOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"tx" base

def backend.hookFnSpec (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b t : Loc) (f :
    GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ st stop m u,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ Pk ∗ ⌜backend.hookPre P st⌝ ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u -∗
              ▷
                  ((∃ st',
                      backend.batchLocked γ P b st' ∗ Pk ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u ∗ ⌜backend.hookStep P st st'⌝) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal f)
                    (intoVal
                      (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                        (intoVal t))))
                  {{ Φ }})

def backend.rdSt_countable : Pos.Countable backend.RdSt :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun x => (x.rtx, x.wg, x.γw, x.γo, x.γt, x.idx, x.win, x.live, x.cln))
    (fun p =>
      { rtx := p.fst, wg := p.snd.fst, γw := p.snd.snd.fst, γo := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, γt := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        idx := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, win := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, live := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cln := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    backend.rdSt_countable._proof_1

def backend.trkHalf (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γ.hkd (Qp.half 1) (backend.hkData P S) ∗ backend.rbSide γ P (backend.rbData P S))

def backend.poisonAt (γ : backend.BNames) (ver : w64) (i : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  (ver, i) ↪[γ.cached]□ false

def backend.isBackend (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∃ t rt tm db lg h,
        typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
            typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchLimit" b) P.limit
                DFrac.discard ∗
              typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"lg" b) lg DFrac.discard ∗
                ⌜lg ≠ null⌝ ∗
                  typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"hooks" b) h DFrac.discard ∗
                    typedPointsto (backend.beOf t) b DFrac.discard ∗
                      typedPointsto (backend.rtmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) tm DFrac.discard ∗
                        backend.hooksSpec γ P Pk b t h ∗
                          sync.isMutex (backend.muOf t) (backend.batchFree γ P W Pk b t) ∗
                            sync.isRWMutexGuard (backend.rmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (backend.rtRes γ P rt) ∗
                              (sync.isRWMutexGuard tm fun q => backend.tmTok γ q) ∗
                                sync.isMutex (backend.cmuOf b) (backend.cacheRes γ P b) ∗
                                  backend.cacheInv γ ∗
                                    backend.metricsInv b ∗
                                      (sync.isRWMutexGuard (backend.bF go!"mu" b) fun q =>
                                          typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"db" b) db (DFrac.own q)) ∗
                                        backend.isDB db ∗ ⌜P.Wf⌝)

def backend.tokPart (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Rat) : IProp GF :=
  if h : 0 < q then ghostVar γ.txa ⟨q, h⟩ () else iprop(True)

def backend.dlReg (γ : backend.BNames) (Φ : GoString × GoString → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(savedPredOwn γ.dlg DFrac.discard Φ ∗ dghostVar γ.dlb DFrac.discard true)

def backend.plHook (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  backend.plHookAt γ (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) f

def backend.bN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"backend"

def backend.fkV (γ : backend.BNames) (w : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n v, dghostVar γ.fkv DFrac.discard (w, n, v))

def backend.wgOpen (γw : GName) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γw q ()

theorem backend.commitReq_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b :
    Loc) (X Y : IProp GF) : Persistent (backend.commitReq γ P Pk b X Y)

def backend.plHookRO (γ : backend.BNames) (f : GoFunc) : IProp GF :=
  backend.plHookAt γ DFrac.discard f

theorem backend.thinV_sub (γ : backend.BNames) (vd L : backend.VData) : backend.thinV γ vd L ⊢ ⌜∀
    (nk : GoString × GoString) (v : GoString), vd !! nk = some v → L !! nk = some v⌝

def backend.keyLe (k k' : w64 × Nat) : Prop :=
  uint.Z k.fst < uint.Z k'.fst ∨ k.fst = k'.fst ∧ k.snd ≤ k'.snd

theorem backend.thinV_refl (γ : backend.BNames) (vd : backend.VData) : ⊢ backend.thinV γ vd vd

theorem backend.rbPartF_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString
    backend.BktData) (F : GoString → Bool) : Timeless (backend.rbPartF γ S r F)

theorem backend.viewSame_thin (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (h :
    backend.viewSame P st) : ⊢ backend.thinV γ (backend.sData P st.S) (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R))
    ∗ ⌜∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st.W.bks i =
    []⌝

def backend.delOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered
    go!"pendingDeleteOperations"
    t

def backend.dlNoDel (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.dlb DFrac.discard false

theorem backend.intvInv_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rtx : Loc) (cm :
    GoMap) (D : backend.Data) : Persistent (backend.intvInv γ P rtx cm D)

def backend.cacheInv (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (backend.bN.@"cached")
    iprop(∃ Cs k win,
        ghostMapAuth γ.cached 1 Cs ∗
          (□ [∗map] k' ↦ b ∈ Cs, k' ↪[γ.cached]□ b) ∗
            ghostVar γ.cur (Qp.half 1) (k, win) ∗
              ghostVar γ.cvw (Qp.half 1) () ∗
                ⌜(∀ (k' : w64 × Nat) (b : Bool), Cs !! k' = some b → backend.keyLe k' k) ∧
                      (win = false → Cs !! k ≠ some false)⌝ ∗
                  (⌜win = false⌝ ∨ ∃ vd, backend.bView γ 1 vd))

theorem backend.fkPut_other (γ : backend.BNames) (n k : GoString) (h : ¬backend.fkKey n k) : ⊢
    backend.fkPut γ n k

def backend.cmuOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (b : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBufferCache go!"mu" (backend.cacheOf b)

theorem backend.fkV_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (w : Bool) : Persistent (backend.fkV γ w)

def backend.rtmuOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"txMu" base

def backend.cacheValid (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) (idx : Nat)
    (L : backend.VData) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ i rv',
        ⌜i ≤ idx⌝ -∗
          backend.histAt γ rv.snd.ver i rv' -∗
            backend.cachedAt γ rv.snd.ver i -∗ backend.thinV γ (backend.vData P (rv.fst, rv'.snd)) L)

def backend.rtHeld (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b rtx : Loc) (rv : backend.RView) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rt rd H L,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗
        sync.ownRWMutexRLocked (backend.rmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (backend.rtRes γ P rt) ∗
          backend.rtResAt γ P rt sync.rfrac rd rv H sync.rfrac.half L ∗ ⌜rd.rtx = rtx ∧ rtx ≠ null⌝ ∗ backend.crTok γ b)

def backend.rbEls (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (q : Qp) (v : GoString → Option
    backend.BktData × Bool) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] n ↦ _u ∈ γ.rbD, if S n then backend.rbElem γ n q (v n) else iprop(True)

def backend.rbOwn (γ : backend.BNames) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : IProp GF :=
  backend.rbPart γ (fun x => True) r

def backend.cacheOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (b : Loc) : Loc :=
  backend.bF
    go!"txReadBufferCache" b

def backend.hooksSpec (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b t : Loc) (h :
    GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜h = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨
      ∃ ho,
        ⌜h = GoInterface.ok ho⌝ ∗
          □
            ∀ st stop m u,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ Pk ∗ ⌜backend.hookPre P st⌝ ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u -∗
                    ▷
                        ((∃ st',
                            backend.batchLocked γ P b st' ∗
                              Pk ∗ backend.payIn γ st stop m u ∗ ⌜backend.hookStep P st st'⌝) -∗
                          Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal
                            (methods ho.ty
                              go!"OnPreCommitUnsafe"
                              ho.v))
                          (intoVal
                            (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                              (intoVal t))))
                        {{ Φ }})

theorem backend.bksAt_discard_persistent (m : GoMap) (Pb : backend.BksPhys) (B : GMap w64 (List
    backend.Ent)) : Persistent (backend.bksAt m DFrac.discard Pb B)

def backend.fkOpen (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) (v : backend.FkVals) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ w, backend.fkVR γ (w, n, v))

theorem backend.relog_same (P : backend.BParams) (L : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) (st :
    backend.BSess) (hs : backend.sData P st.S = backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) (hsub : ∀ (nk :
    GoString × GoString) (v : GoString), backend.vData P (st.C, st.R) !! nk = some v → L !! nk =
    some v) : backend.relog P L st = L

def backend.cacheRes (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ bp ver,
      typedPointsto (backend.cbufOf b) bp (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto (backend.cverOf b) ver (DFrac.own 1) ∗ (⌜bp = null⌝ ∨ backend.cacheEnt γ P bp ver))

def backend.muOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTx go!"Mutex" (backend.btOf t)

theorem backend.bbAt_discard_persistent (bb : Loc) (p : backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent) :
    Persistent (backend.bbAt bb DFrac.discard p es)

def backend.fkVR (γ : backend.BNames) (g : backend.FkG) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.fkv DFrac.discard g

def backend.rbktOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (base : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.baseReadTx go!"buckets" base

def backend.dlIs (γ : backend.BNames) (nk : GoString × GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Φ, backend.dlReg γ Φ ∗ □ Φ nk)

def backend.rdMax : Nat :=
  2 ^ 31 - 2

structure backend.BNames : Type where
  db : backend.DBNames
  view : GName
  rd : GName
  hist : GName
  cached : GName
  cur : GName
  hook : GName
  opn : GName
  wb : GName
  rdt : GName
  txa : GName
  txb : GName
  rvs : GName
  cvw : GName
  wbc : GName
  used : GName
  cls : GName
  sdn : GName
  stk : GName
  hkd : GName
  rbk : GName
  cln : GName
  dlg : GName
  dlb : GName
  fk : GName
  fkv : GName
  rbD : GMap GoString Unit

def backend.bView (γ : backend.BNames) (q : Qp) (vd : backend.VData) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c, backend.bViewC γ q vd c)

theorem backend.cmFacts_timeless (P : backend.BParams) (rtx : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (M : GMap w64
    Loc) : Timeless (backend.cmFacts P rtx D M)

def backend.fkOwn (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatAuthOwn γ.fk (Qp.half 1) n

def backend.rtResAt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (rt : Loc) (q : Qp) (rd :
    backend.RdSt) (rv : backend.RView) (H : GMap (w64 × Nat) backend.RView) (p : Qp := q.half) (L :
    backend.VData := backend.vData P rv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m Pb cm,
      backend.rbAt (backend.rbufOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (DFrac.own q) m Pb rv.snd ∗
        ⌜backend.bksOk Pb rv.snd.bks⌝ ∗
          typedPointsto (backend.rbktOf (backend.baseOf rt)) cm (DFrac.own q) ∗ backend.rtRest γ P rt q rd rv cm H p L)

theorem backend.cmFacts_persistent (P : backend.BParams) (rtx : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (M : GMap
    w64 Loc) : Persistent (backend.cmFacts P rtx D M)

def backend.rbPartF (γ : backend.BNames) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData)
    (F : GoString → Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∀ (n : GoString), S n → γ.rbD !! n = none → r !! n = none⌝ ∗
      backend.rbEls γ S (Qp.half 1) fun n => (r !! n, F n))

theorem backend.commitReq_true (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc)
    : ⊢ backend.commitReq γ P Pk b iprop(True) iprop(True)

def backend.beOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (t : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTx go!"backend"
    (backend.btOf t)

theorem backend.fkPut_eq (γ : backend.BNames) (n k : GoString) (h : ¬backend.fkKey n k) :
    backend.fkPut γ n k = iprop(True)

theorem backend.isBackend_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b
    : Loc) : Persistent (backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b)

def backend.cverOf [GoSemanticsFunctions] (b : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBufferCache
    go!"bufVersion" (backend.cacheOf b)

theorem backend.rdB_persistent (rtx : Loc) (s : GoSlice) (b : GoString) : Persistent (backend.rdB
    rtx s b)

def backend.bF [GoSemanticsFunctions] (f : GoString) (b : Loc) : Loc :=
  structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend f b
